issues.failure_explanation: X_l^+ contains fine hat functions of old vertices whose patch changed. Take a bisection of edge (a,b) shared by triangles (a,b,c) and (a,b,d), with c interior. Then c is in V_l^+, and the coarse hat phi_{l-1,c} equals phi_{l,c}, because it vanishes at the new midpoint. So phi_{l-1,c} lies in the intersection of X_{l-1}^1 and X_l^+, and the sum is not direct. Only X_l^1 = X_{l-1}^1 + X_l^+ holds.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the direct sum by an ordinary (overlapping) sum.
issues.overall_effect: The stated space splitting is false. No proof in the paper uses the directness of the sum, so no result is invalidated.

issues.failure_explanation: The cited Proposition gives contraction for Algorithm geometric MG with the level-wise optimal (residual-dependent) step-sizes. Replacing every step-size by the fixed value 1/(d+1) gives a different iteration. Its error is not comparable to the greedy optimal-step iteration, because each step choice changes all later levels. The paper gives no argument for contraction of the fixed-step version, let alone with the same factor q. The SPD and condition-number proof of the corollary rests entirely on eq: linearized MG contracion with this q.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: Based on~\eqref{eq: strengthened CS intermediate} and the definition~\eqref{eq: G operator} of $\GG_{\ell,m}^1$, it only remains to prove that

issues.failure_explanation: Step 1 bounds each term by the global |||v_k||| times |||P_{l',z} w_k|||. Step 2 then needs the sum over patches of |||P w_k||| to be bounded by |||w_k|||. Finite overlap only gives the bound for the sum of squares. A sum of N local norms can be about sqrt(N)|||w_k|||, e.g. when w_k's energy is spread evenly over N level-m patches. The claimed bound is therefore false in general, and the lemma's proof fails.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Apply the uniform strengthened Cauchy-Schwarz inequality elementwise to the aggregate G_{l,m}^1 w_k, which lies in the uniform level-m space. Bound its L2 norm by h_m times the square root of the sum of |||P w_k|||^2, using finite overlap and the C_lev bound, and use squared-sum finite overlap to get at most |||w_k|||^2.
issues.overall_effect: The upper bound in eq: AS operator bounds, and hence the h- and p-robust condition-number bound for the AS preconditioner, is not established by the given argument.
issues.title: Strengthened Cauchy-Schwarz for G_{l,m}: sum of local norms bounded by global norm (invalid)
